pulpit.title: Dashboard
pulpit.lead: New cases appear here on their own — the numbers refresh every 10 seconds.

flow.heading: How a new case reaches the team
flow.step1: A resident, organisation or municipality sends a case or an idea and gets a case code.
flow.step2: The team sees it straight away: the Notifications bell in the panel, a counter in the browser tab title and an e-mail to the ROPS team inbox.
flow.step3: The AI assistant sorts it first: area, urgency, similar cases, a suggested expert and a reply draft quoting the Library.
flow.step4: A staff member checks the draft and replies. The reply reaches the author on the case page and, if they left contact details, through the channel they chose.
